# The Citizen

> South Africa's leading news platform delivering breaking news, local newspapers, premium digital content, and exclusive shopping deals across the nation.

The Citizen is a major South African news organization providing comprehensive coverage of national and local news, with integrated services including digital subscriptions, e-Paper access, local newspaper directories, and curated shopping content through The Citizen Create platform.

## Key Topics

- South Africa
- Breaking News
- Digital Subscription
- e-Paper
- Local Newspapers
- Black Friday Deals
- South African Retailers
- Job Listings
- Government Employment
- Compensation Fund

- Premium Content
- Caxton Publishers
